qa_pair.question: Inspect the default ConnectConfig capability set and the exported read-only capability constants. What exact capability value is advertised by default? Answer with the value only.
Compare the default ConnectConfig discovery setting with the runtime's discovery lifecycle evidence. Is discovery enabled by default? Answer True or False only.
Trace the default ConnectConfig port through the server constant that defines the peer service port. What is the default preferred port? Answer with the integer only.
Use the runtime configuration and discovery definitions to identify the fully qualified service type used for peer discovery. Answer with the exact service type only.
Inspect failure classification and RetryState.record_failure. When the failure is authentication_failed or identity_changed, what is the resulting automatic_retry boolean? Answer True or False only.

Follow the bounded retry calculation for three consecutive connection_refused failures using the default base delay and no jitter. List the three delays in seconds, in order, separated by comma and space.
Inspect RoleAssignment normalization and the cluster role enum. If a node is assigned coordinator, which additional role is implicitly included? Answer with the role value only.
Compare the default runtime cluster setting with the MCP cluster audit permissions. Is cluster participation enabled by default? Answer True or False only.
Inspect the MCP annotations, configuration defaults, and the cluster audit documentation. What exact execution flag gates an actual failover transition? Answer with the flag name only.
Compare the default capability and permission enums, then identify the shared read-only value used for the default grant. Answer with the exact value only.
